messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout v2026-03-19-1784 -> prod started. Canary eu1 (5%). Post-deploy probes: kv-warmup, embed-synth, latency-heartbeat. Will report probe statuses in thread.

morgan: embed-synth failing in eu1, started ~+2m after canary. small error rate but p95 latency up. :eyes:

lee: details? logs or a quick grep?

morgan: snippet from canary logs:
```
ERROR embed-synth: context loop timeout after 12000ms
WARN kv-cache: key miss spike
```

sam: @morgan can you run the smoke command with verbose and paste output? `deployctl smoke run --target=eu1 --test=embed-synth --verbose`

morgan: ran it, summary: fail 18/200 requests, p50 120ms p95 820ms. baseline p95 ~220ms. errors look like timeouts, not 5xx payloads.

kelsey: any infra events around the window?

raj: infra console shows a host OOM on eu1-gpu-3 at 10:12 UTC (matches canary). k8s restarted the pod once.

lee: sounds like noisy neighbor / resource pressure. recommendation: hold the rest of the rollout and pin canary back to previous model variant v1.12.3 while we investigate.

sam: agree. rollback command: `deployctl rollback --canary --to v1.12.3` — I'll trigger and notify oncall.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by @sam. Canary traffic reverted to v1.12.3. Notifying #oncall and pausing staggered rollout. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

morgan: opening incident ticket INC-2026-321, will attach logs, smoke output, and repro steps.

kelsey: follow-up: add a probe gate that auto-holds rollout when embed-synth p95 > 2x baseline for >2m. Also consider excluding eu1-gpu-3 from next canary batch.

lee: created a tiny PR to tighten thresholds for embed-synth probe and to add host-exclude tagging for canaries (link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/462).

sam: thumbs up. After rollback settles, let's re-run full synthetic suite and a focused KV warmup on eu1 before we reattempt.

morgan: re-run results will be posted here. closing the loop after validation. :lock:
